title: vault.search input
description: Bounded snapshot request over the retrieval-eligible vault pool served by the SilverBullet adapter. R0: the request reads the loopback vault through the governed adapter and produces no side effects. Namespace scoping is configuration-only and never caller-visible: a caller can only narrow what the adapter already admits, never widen it. A missing or unhealthy vault service is a typed unavailable outcome, never an empty success. There is no query field: ranking belongs to the M11 brain retrieval over the indexed pool.
